rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: Pending Senate bill that would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in the Massachusetts rental housing market. The source does not show the bill text or its specific provisions.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental housing in Massachusetts. The bill text is not shown, so specific coverage terms are unknown.
rules.citation: Mass. S.2983 (194th General Court), new draft of S.994 and S.1016
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.conflict_note: Reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means. There are no further actions as of the retrieval date, and the bill is not enacted. Its substantive provisions are not shown on the bill history page.
